problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Minimize F(w)=n⁻¹∑ᵢ log Eξ∼lawᵢ[exp(scoreᵢ(w,ξ))] over a nonempty closed convex domain. Each sampled score satisfies a supporting-subgradient inequality, implying convexity of the scores and F. Differentiability and smoothness are not required.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositionalEntropicRisk.lean: objective; spec.admissible, domain conditions and score supporting inequality.

problem_class.label: composite
problem_class.details: Nested nonlinear composition log E exp(score), rather than an additive smooth-plus-proximable decomposition.

problem_class.label: finite_sum
problem_class.details: The objective averages n≥1 entropic-risk terms, each containing an expectation under its own hidden probability law.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositionalEntropicRisk.lean: Params.n and nonzero; Instance.law; normalizer; objective.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: A sample query at w returns a uniform random index i and two conditionally independent sampled score/subgradient pairs for that same i. These are subgradients of sampled scores, not an unbiased gradient oracle for F. The caller cannot select i or reuse the hidden sample at another point.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositionalEntropicRisk.lean: Query.sample; Reply.sample; Seed; sampleLaw; sampleOracle; spec.admissible supporting inequality.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: Each sampling reply includes two sampled score values; neither the normalizer nor the objective value is returned.

oracle.label: proximal
oracle.details: Exact metric projection onto the hidden domain is available as a separate query. Sampling and projection queries consume the same oracle budget; one sampling query returns both pairs.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositionalEntropicRisk.lean: Query.projection; sampleOracle; spec.admissible projection inequalities. LongTails/Template.lean: Algorithm.query; executeWithTrace; _run.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniformly over i and feasible w, writing Zᵢ(w)=E exp(scoreᵢ(w,ξ)), the assumptions are E‖gradᵢ(w,ξ)‖²≤G², E exp(2 scoreᵢ(w,ξ))≤κ Zᵢ(w)², and E[exp(2 scoreᵢ(w,ξ))‖gradᵢ(w,ξ)‖²]≤σ² Zᵢ(w)². These are second-moment bounds, not a centered variance bound for an unbiased objective-gradient oracle; σ=0 is permitted.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositionalEntropicRisk.lean: normalizer; spec.valid; spec.admissible, three moment inequalities.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is a second-countable real Hilbert space with its Borel measurable structure, without a finite-dimensional restriction. Scores lie pointwise in [c0,c1]. Oracle seeds are IID across calls, and the two samples are independent conditional on their shared index. A minimizer exists within distance R of feasible w0; no domain-diameter bound is assumed. All Params are public, including n, B≥1, c0≤c1, G>0, κ≥1, σ≥0, R≥0 and ε>0; scores, subgradients, laws and domain are hidden.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositionalEntropicRisk.lean: Params; Instance; sampleLaw; spec.publicInput, valid and admissible. LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID.measurable, independent and marginal.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The measurable output ŵ must have an integrable objective gap satisfying E[F(ŵ)−F(w*)]≤ε for a domain minimizer w*.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The output belongs to the domain for every outcome, not merely almost surely.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Accuracy is in expectation over the joint algorithm and oracle randomness under a fixed oracle-call budget; no high-probability objective-gap guarantee is required.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: An established entropic-risk formulation with a specialized paired-sampling oracle, normalized exponential moment bounds, general Hilbert-space geometry, and a shared sampling/projection budget. This classification does not assert novelty. Repository proofs and implementations were not inspected; no qualifying reference verified here is not evidence that none exists.
